I built the site as a single static page, `index.html`, in the project folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is untested.

- **Header and hero:** a dark bar with the logo, the What's New, Forums and Login / Join links, and a Join Community button. Below it is the site description with 414K posts, 180.3K members and "since 2003".
- **Latest discussion threads:** three cards, each with its photo, poster and reply count, linked to the thread.

- **Recommended communities:** three cards, with Royal Enfield Forum marked NEW.
- **Join section:** "Join now to ask and comment!" with the Facebook, Google and email sign-up buttons.
- **Footer:** the site links, the VerticalScope address, the XenForo credit and the non-affiliation disclaimer.

The page uses the images straight from `images/`, so keep that folder next to `index.html`. Links to the forum use the full `https://www.insightcentral.net` address, so they open the live site.

The brief didn't say what to write in the image alt text, so I wrote short descriptions myself. Check they suit you. I also added a short line under the join heading ("Create an account to start joining the conversation.") that isn't in the brief.
